_comment: OpenClaw integration template values + region allocation policy. Copy to config.json and edit. Values mirror RealityEngine_CPP/config/integrations.example.json (openclaw-xacp + acp-openclaw-completion) and localOpenClawStack docker-compose defaults.

completionLane._comment: The single arbitrated service lane every agent completion reaches the vector through. Declared as acp-openclaw-completion in RealityEngine_Machines domains/region-allocation.json serviceLanes. Agents do NOT get per-agent regions: the per-machine completion band was retired in RealityEngine_Machines#63/#64, and four cells cannot be subdivided across 1300+ agents. Which agent produced a completion is carried by the dispatch ledger, not by distinct cells.

syntheticBody._comment: Synthetic action answer (synthetic_body.py, README §1.3a). When an action's real turn fails to report, it answers on the completion lane with an answer the action contract admits. mode: off | fallback (only when the model fails or does not resolve) | always (never call the model). strategy: seeded-random | round-robin. domains.<domain> overrides this block; OC_SYNTHETIC_MODE / OC_SYNTHETIC_STRATEGY override both. Synthetic completions carry metadata.synthetic=true.
